n8ebcd6f520.headline: Mining drives Mongolia’s economy as reform momentum builds
n8ebcd6f520.summary: Mongolia's steady growth is driven by mining, according to analysis. The new government faces a high-stakes test of its attempt at economic transformation.
n8ebcd6f520.why: Mongolia's economy depends heavily on copper and coal exports, mainly to China, so mining output and commodity prices shape its growth. Reform progress affects foreign investment appetite.

ne5827211df.headline: Tanzania Lures Domestic, Foreign Investors to Boost Sugar Industry
ne5827211df.summary: The Tanzanian government is seeking domestic and foreign direct investment in its sugar industry. The aim is to close a long-standing shortage of sugar supply.
ne5827211df.why: Sugar production investment affects food supply, import needs and agribusiness returns in African economies.

n656c02f189.headline: Uganda: New AfCFTA-Agra Alliance Targets Farmer-Centered Intra-African Trade
n656c02f189.summary: The African Continental Free Trade Area Secretariat and the Alliance for a Green Revolution in Africa have agreed a partnership to accelerate intra-African agricultural trade amid worsening food insecurity.
n656c02f189.why: The AfCFTA is the African Union's free trade area, and expanding intra-African agricultural trade affects food supply and regional commerce.

nef7b4bfe6e.headline: The Supreme Court rejects Donald Trump's tariffs. The US president: "It's a shame, I have a backup plan"
nef7b4bfe6e.summary: The Supreme Court rejected Donald Trump's tariffs with six votes in favour and three against, ruling that he cannot impose them under the cited authority. Trump said he has a backup plan.
nef7b4bfe6e.why: Tariff policy changes trade costs, import prices and the outlook for companies with global supply chains, making court rulings on tariffs market-relevant.
nef7b4bfe6e.why_moved: The court ruled the president cannot impose these tariffs, removing a trade-cost measure, while he has said he has a backup plan.

nb479beade5.headline: Spain Launches New 30-Year Government Bond With 7 Billion Euro Deal Size
nb479beade5.summary: Spain launched a new 30-year government bond with a 7 billion euro deal size, drawing robust demand through a bank syndicate on Tuesday.
nb479beade5.why: Long-dated government bonds set benchmark yields for Spanish borrowing costs and inform pricing across European fixed income.

n0d95c71bbc.headline: EU countries give final approval to weaken company sustainability laws
n0d95c71bbc.summary: EU countries gave final approval on Tuesday to scale back rules requiring companies to address environmental and human rights risks in supply chains. The measure follows months of negotiations.
n0d95c71bbc.why: EU sustainability due diligence rules set obligations for large companies operating in Europe, so changes affect compliance costs and supply-chain obligations for multinationals.

n88a8be6986.headline: Sinn Fein opposing EU loan for Ukraine like supporting surrender – Taoiseach
n88a8be6986.summary: Taoiseach Micheal Martin said Sinn Fein's opposition to an EU loan for Ukraine amounts to supporting surrender. Martin said Russia would be delighted with that approach.
n88a8be6986.why: EU financing for Ukraine involves member-state budgets and guarantees, so Irish political positions on the loan bear on EU fiscal and geopolitical commitments.

n9f803e1bc4.headline: Brazil Cuts Mineral Deals with India and South Korea
n9f803e1bc4.summary: Brazil and India finalised a deal on critical minerals and rare earths on Saturday. A separate agreement between Brazil and South Korea followed.
n9f803e1bc4.why: Critical minerals and rare earths are inputs to batteries, electronics and defence products. Supply agreements affect long-term commodity flows.

n0449dfabdc.headline: Sensex, Nifty prediction for tomorrow: Levels and trading strategy   Will stock market bounce back after crash today? - BusinessToday
n0449dfabdc.summary: The Sensex settled down 1,068.74 points, or 1.28%, at 82,225.92. The Nifty closed at 25,424.65, down 288.35 points or 1.12%, after falling to a low of 25,327.60.
n0449dfabdc.why: The Sensex and Nifty are India's main benchmark equity indices, tracking large listed companies. Their moves reflect sentiment across the Indian equity market.
n0449dfabdc.why_moved: The input reports a sharp one-day decline in both benchmarks but does not give a specific cause.

na78a7a4424.headline: Jaishankar holds talks with GCC Secretary General AlBudaiwi
na78a7a4424.summary: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar held talks in New Delhi with GCC Secretary General Jasem Mohamed AlBudaiwi. The discussions focused on energy, trade and investment cooperation.
na78a7a4424.why: The Gulf Cooperation Council is a bloc of Gulf oil producers, and India is a major energy importer, so ties shape crude supply and trade flows.

nefb20aa7dc.headline: Markets Slide as Trump Threatens New Tariff Policies
nefb20aa7dc.summary: Markets slid after a fresh 15% global tariff was announced by Trump. The report describes the announcement as renewed turmoil for markets.
nefb20aa7dc.why: Broad tariffs raise import costs and can squeeze corporate margins and global trade flows, which is why equity markets react quickly to new trade measures.
nefb20aa7dc.why_moved: A new 15% global tariff announcement raised concerns about trade costs and corporate earnings, triggering a market sell-off.

n50e27197a0.headline: India, Israel begin talks for free trade pact
n50e27197a0.summary: India and Israel have started the first round of negotiations for a free trade agreement in New Delhi. The four-day talks aim to boost commercial ties and promote investment, an official said.
n50e27197a0.why: Free trade agreements reduce tariffs and non-tariff barriers, which can expand bilateral trade and investment flows between the two economies.

nea8036e499.headline: IT industry likely to hire 135,000 employees in FY26, projects Nasscom - BusinessToday
nea8036e499.summary: India's IT industry is likely to hire 135,000 employees in FY26, Nasscom projects. AI-related revenues of IT companies are expected to rise significantly, officials said.
nea8036e499.why: India's IT services sector is a major source of export revenue and white-collar employment, and its hiring is closely tied to global client demand and AI spending.

n7f06777914.headline: India's technology sector to expand 6% to $315 billion in fiscal 2026, industry body says
n7f06777914.summary: An Indian industry body projects the country's technology sector will expand 6% to $315 billion in fiscal 2026, driven by AI services amid market challenges.
n7f06777914.why: India is a major global hub for IT services and outsourcing, so growth in its tech sector matters for global technology spending and service exporters.

nded036f7d8.headline: IPO-bound CleanMax to invest ₹1,200 cr in 200 MW AP solar park
nded036f7d8.summary: IPO-bound CleanMax plans to invest ₹1,200 crore in a 200 MW solar park in Andhra Pradesh, generating 445 million units of clean power annually.
nded036f7d8.why: CleanMax is an Indian renewable energy company, and its capacity additions and planned IPO are relevant to investors in India's clean power sector.

n14cc05437f.headline: Woodside posts record production as soft prices drag
n14cc05437f.summary: Australia's biggest oil and gas producer posted record production and cut production costs, but weak commodity prices weighed on results.
n14cc05437f.why: Woodside is Australia's largest oil and gas producer, so its earnings are sensitive to global oil and LNG prices.

n6668bd3ba7.headline: Tata Sons puts Chandrasekaran’s reappointment on hold after board differences: Report - BusinessToday
n6668bd3ba7.summary: Tata Sons has put the reappointment of Chandrasekaran on hold after board differences, according to a report. Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata was reported as the only board member opposing it.
n6668bd3ba7.why: Tata Sons is the holding company of the Tata Group, whose listed companies span autos, steel, IT services and more; leadership decisions affect the group's governance.

nec67adb1a6.headline: The 'stealthy' price-setter of Australian energy bills
nec67adb1a6.summary: An article argues that Australians paying more for power should look at pricey gas and energy market dynamics. It describes gas as a stealthy price-setter for electricity.
nec67adb1a6.why: Gas is a marginal price-setter in Australia's wholesale electricity market, so gas costs flow through to household and business power bills.

nfc9a940459.headline: Tata Sons Board Defers N. Chandrasekaran
nfc9a940459.summary: A boardroom rift at Tata Sons led to the deferral of Chairman N. Chandrasekaran's tenure extension. Disagreements over strategy, rising losses and capital discipline were cited.
nfc9a940459.why: Tata Sons is the holding company of the Tata Group, one of India's largest conglomerates, so leadership and capital decisions affect its many listed subsidiaries.

n7d26f102c1.headline: Singapore's SATS to develop world class cargo complex at Jewar airport - BusinessToday
n7d26f102c1.summary: Singapore's SATS will develop a world-class cargo complex at Jewar airport and establish a Taj SATS air catering kitchen serving Jewar and other North India airports.
n7d26f102c1.why: SATS is a Singapore-listed airport services group handling catering and cargo, so new airport contracts affect its growth in India.

n77410a748b.headline: Despite Lower House dominance, Takaichi puts emphasis on cooperation
n77410a748b.summary: Prime Minister Takaichi urged opposition parties to work with her coalition to pass the fiscal 2026 budget before the end of March. Her coalition has less dominance in the lower house.
n77410a748b.why: The national budget sets government spending and tax policy, which influence Japanese bond yields and the outlook for the economy.

n74d5ebce9a.headline: Budget 2026 repositions SMEs for long-term tough environment: DBS
n74d5ebce9a.summary: DBS said Budget 2026 positions SMEs for a long-term tough environment. It highlighted AI, internationalisation, workforce transformation and financing as key capability areas.
n74d5ebce9a.why: DBS is a major Singapore-based bank, and its SME lending and advisory role links government budget policy to small business financing.

n3c73b73955.headline: Anthropricks IT Again; St in Pain
n3c73b73955.summary: Anthropic's blog post sparked a second wave of selling in Indian IT stocks in three weeks. Concern over the outlook for India's software services sector dragged benchmark indices lower.
n3c73b73955.why: India's IT services exporters earn much of their revenue from global clients, so shifts in expectations for AI-driven demand weigh on the sector and on the broader Indian equity market.
n3c73b73955.why_moved: Anthropic's blog post renewed panic selling in IT stocks, and mounting anxiety over the sector's outlook dragged benchmark indices down.

nd68f586ff7.headline: Biz sentiment for March turns positive on strong exports in S. Korea
nd68f586ff7.summary: South Korea's business sentiment turned positive for March, marking the first rebound in four years. The improvement was attributed to robust exports.
nd68f586ff7.why: Business sentiment surveys are a leading indicator of investment and hiring decisions in export-dependent economies such as South Korea. Export strength feeds directly into the won and the Kospi.

n90b64e84b7.headline: Supreme Court ruling against Trump’s tariffs is unlikely to mean an end to trade policy chaos - The Boston Globe
n90b64e84b7.summary: The Supreme Court struck down tariffs imposed by President Trump. Open questions include whether other laws can rebuild the tariffs and withstand legal challenges.
n90b64e84b7.why: US tariffs shape import costs, supply chains and trade relations with major partners, so court rulings on them affect corporate margins and global trade flows.

n9dc2540ffc.headline: US stocks rise after getting a reminder of AI's potential upsides
n9dc2540ffc.summary: The US stock market rose after a reminder that the artificial-intelligence technology boom may also have an upside. The article gives no index levels.
n9dc2540ffc.why: The S&P 500 is the main US large-cap equity benchmark, and AI-related companies carry significant weight in it.
n9dc2540ffc.why_moved: Investors reacted to signs that the AI boom may offer upside, lifting US equities.

nf0edb43219.headline: In Qatar, Pakistan’s Sharif seeks to bolster trade ties, woo foreign capital
nf0edb43219.summary: Pakistan's Prime Minister Sharif is in Qatar seeking to bolster trade ties and attract international investment. Pakistan is recovering from a severe economic crisis.
nf0edb43219.why: Qatar is a Gulf sovereign investor, and its capital and trade links can support recovery efforts in economies like Pakistan's.

n270c1c8828.headline: Gogoro (GGR) Achieves Record Annual EBITDA and Triples Operating Cash Flow in 2025
n270c1c8828.summary: Gogoro reported record full-year 2025 adjusted EBITDA of $59.9 million, up from $44.7 million a year earlier. The company credited execution and cost discipline for the results.
n270c1c8828.why: Gogoro is a Taiwan-based electric scooter and battery-swapping company, and its profitability indicates progress in electric two-wheeler markets.

n9851876393.headline: SBS Transit reports 2.7% dip in group revenue to S$1.52 billion for 2025
n9851876393.summary: SBS Transit reported 2025 group revenue down 2.7% to S$1.52 billion and proposed a special dividend of 31.99 cents per share on top of a final dividend of 8.66 cents.
n9851876393.why: SBS Transit is a Singapore public transport operator whose bus and rail revenues depend on ridership and fare-related income.
